name: sonzai-sdk
description: Two skills for Sonzai SDK developers: (1) sonzai-sdk — wizard-driven; prescribes archetype + memory mode + runtime mode (full-chat vs memory-layer via sessions vs memory-layer via /process) + capabilities; drives spec → review → plan. (2) full-auto — autonomous closed-loop: takes a meeting transcript, dispatches a builder subagent, exercises the built app (API + UI), feeds failures back until it works. Covers 7 archetypes across Python / TypeScript / Go. BYOK is the recommended production posture.
